_comment: Distribution limits use the worst observed value ± 3 sample SDs, rounded outward, from `npm run calibrate:phonemes` (30 non-overlapping RNG streams, sampleSize words, lexicon, morphology off). This is an engineering margin, not a false-failure probability guarantee. Inventory coverage is fixed at 0: calibration fails on any generated-only mass, missing CMU phonemes, or rejected tokens. Recalibration measures a change; justify any loosened limit with its linguistic benefit and leave unaffected limits unchanged. Shared Pearson r is reported but not gated (2026-11 recalibration). See TUNING.md. 2026-11-13: minRepresentation and maxAbsoluteGapPct loosened after forbidOpenCheckedFinal removed open-final /ɪ ɛ æ ʌ ʊ/ (issue #398); /ɪ/ under-rep and abs gap moved while TV/over-rep stayed within prior limits (5-seed recalibration). 2026-11-17: maxOverRepresentation loosened 1.066→1.08 after #440 banned illegal joins /z.ʃ/, /ʃ.h/, /k.tʃ/ (drop-coda repairs); seed-42 /u/ over-rep 1.063→1.068 and 30-stream worst 1.0679 (SD 0.0040). Other limits unchanged (observed extrema still inside prior bounds). Recalibrated on #451 head (pre-#443 revert) via `npm run calibrate:phonemes`.
